newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket - SAfrica Gibbs hits unbeaten 200 v India A.
newsitem.headline: Cricket - SAfrica Gibbs hits unbeaten 200 v India A.

text.p: Herschelle Gibbs scored a brilliant unbeaten 200 as South Africa rattled up 384 runs for the loss of five wickets by close on the first day of their three-day match against an Indian A selection on Tuesday.
Gibbs, 22, hit four sixes and 28 fours in an impressive display of attacking batsmanship as the home side toiled.
Gibbs, who opened the innings, put on 215 runs for the fifth wicket with Derek Crookes.

Crookes, who scored a patient 76 off 177 balls, was out when he miscued a lofted drive off paceman D. Ganesh to Navjot Sidhu at mid-on. Wicket-keeper Dave Richardson was batting on 10 at close with Gibbs.

The first day's play provided valuable batting practice for the South Africans ahead of the third test which starts in Kanpur on Sunday. India and South Africa have won one match each in the three-test series.
The home side's bowlers would have disappointed the three Indian selectors watching the match as the South Africans hammered them at will.

Only Ganesh, who hails from the southern state of Karnataka, home of India's two other test pacers Javagal Srinath and Venkatesh Prasad, was promising as he picked up three wickets, two of them in the space of three balls.
He finished with figures of three for 69 off 23 overs.
